verdict.rationale: Cursor's MCP docs show explicit admin/user controls: enterprise admins can restrict which MCP servers are allowed via dashboard, users can toggle individual servers on/off, and Cursor requires approval before invoking any MCP tool by default — directly matching the engineering-lead's need to govern external tool access. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the enterprise admin control panel in practice, and detail on granular per-tool (vs per-server) permission scoping.
